metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2001 · The Inspector Lynley Mysteries
metas.description: British crime investigation series based around aristocratic, Oxford-educated Detective Inspector Thomas Lynley and his working-class assistant Sergeant Barbara Havers.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1961 · The Misfits
metas.description: A divorcée falls for an over-the-hill cowboy who is struggling to maintain his romantically independent lifestyle.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · Portobello
metas.description: In the early '80s, Enzo Tortora is one of the most beloved figures on Italian television. But in the midst of Italy's war against organized crime, Enzo's life is upended when he's falsely connected to the notorious Camorra criminal ring.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · The Intern
metas.description: A story about what happens when  Seon-wu, the CEO of a fashion company who is more passionate than anyone when it comes to work, hires Ki-ho, who has a wealth of life experience, as a silver intern.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2026 · The Early Spring
metas.description: Fresh graduate Shang Zhitao joins a top global ad agency as a rookie. Her blunt boss Luan Nian tells her to quit on day one, but she perseveres through pressure and challenges to become a skilled professional.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2016 · Paranoid
metas.description: The murder of a female GP in a rural playground in front of numerous witnesses draws a group of detectives into an ever-darkening mystery that takes them across Europe, aided by mysterious notes sent by the "Ghost Detective".

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2019 · The Art of Racing in the Rain
metas.description: Through his bond with his owner, aspiring Formula One race car driver Denny, golden retriever Enzo learns that the techniques needed on the racetrack can also be used to successfully navigate the journey of life.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2010 · Confessions
metas.description: Yuko, a teacher of middle-school, is shattered to see her four-year-old daughter dead. She returns back to the school and finds out that her students are responsible for her daughter's murder.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2020 · Deadwater Fell
metas.description: When a seemingly perfect and happy family is murdered by someone they knew and trusted, cracks appear on the surface of a supposedly idyllic community.

metas.name: 2026 · The Doll
metas.description: A Polish literary classic reimagined for modern times explores the dangerous intersection of love and obsession. An ambitious man's ruthless pursuit of high society status becomes entangled with his fixation on a woman named Izabela.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
metas.description: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2018 · Vada Chennai
metas.description: A young carrom player in north Chennai becomes a reluctant participant in a war between two warring gangsters.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · Fjord
metas.description: An immigrant Romanian family living in Norway is subject to an investigation and faces the scrutiny of the local judicial system.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · Ranabaali
metas.description: Set in 19th-century British India, a fierce leader rises from a drought-stricken land to fight colonial oppression and atrocities.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2026 · Leaving North Korea
metas.description: A young North Korean refugee fights to rebuild her life in fast-paced, hyper-modern South Korea, forcing her to confront the price of freedom and the past she left behind.

metas.name: 2026 · The Last Sunrise
metas.description: A young American woman with health challenges finds unexpected romance with a charismatic local during her summer in Majorca, forcing her to weigh her heart's desires against family obligations and her planned return home.

metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 2025 · It Ends
metas.description: Friends on a late-night food run become trapped on an infinite highway with otherworldly terrors lurking beyond. Confined in their car, they must decide whether to accept their fate or attempt escape.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2026 · Emperor vs Sarat Chandra
metas.description: Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay, loved for his humanist novels, finds himself at the center of a storm when he writes Pather Dabi—a fierytale of Sabyasachi, a revolutionary whose ideas electrify the youth.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2026 · Tenzing
metas.description: The untold and inspiring tale of one of the most important mountain climbers in history who, with Edmund Hillary, became the first person to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

metas.name: 2026 · Doing Life
metas.description: A single mother fighting to survive and a reformed ex-con with untapped talent find in each other an unlikely second chance.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2021 · Professor T
metas.description: Professor Jasper Tempest, a genius Cambridge University criminologist with OCD and an overbearing mother, assists the police in solving crime.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2026 · My Bias, My Boss
metas.description: A romantic comedy about Nam Da Reum, who joins a company led by former idol-turned-CEO Lee Chan, and unexpectedly finds herself in a romance with the company's boss, Kang Ha Gi.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2026 · Pennum Porattum
metas.description: When a woman and her dog face public hostility, a village's hidden tensions erupt. A stark examination of mob mentality, social judgment, and how communities can turn cruel when seeking to punish perceived wrongs.

metas.name: 2026 · Whalefall
metas.description: Follows a scuba diver who, while looking for his father's remains, is swallowed by an 80-foot, 60-ton sperm whale and has just one hour to get out before his oxygen runs out.

metas.name: 2026 · Love of Your Life
metas.description: Maya, a smart, wry nurse, is swept up in an immersive love, that sets her life on a trajectory she never would have imagined.

metas.name: ★ 9.1 · 2026 · Comrade Kalyan
metas.description: In a naxal-dominated village on the Andhra-Odisha border, a theatre owner uses communist sentiment to keep his old cinema running. He joins the naxals and kidnaps a leader, setting off a chain of events.

metas.name: 2026 · Anna Pigeon
metas.description: Park ranger Anna Pigeon left city life after personal tragedy. Now she channels her pain into investigating crimes in national parks, determined to solve cases despite any obstacles.
